last_response.answer: Practical wisdom here weighs the agent’s unique capacity, immediacy, and scale of threatened loss. challenge_response.answer: Life belongs to the basic liberty of Personal Freedom and Bodily Integrity. Pulling the lever constitutes a direct, coercive act that intentionally brings about the death of the one person; therefore A0 directly infringes that person’s basic liberty. By contrast A1 involves no such coercive restriction; the five deaths arise from a natural contingency outside the agent’s institutional control. This resolves the lexical-priority test: a direct infringement of any individual’s equal basic liberty cannot be justified by benefits to others, so A1 must be chosen.
